name: Aam panna
description: Roasted green mango pulp with cumin, mint and salt — the drink given against heatstroke.

tcm.note: Sour unripe fruit; no classical entry.

ayurveda.note: Unripe mango is amla-rasa and ushna in the classical reading, whatever the drink is used for.

unani.note: The standard desi drink against loo — thanda in practice, which is the whole point of it.

histamine.note: Green mango base, sour and concentrated.
